_comment: The texts of the AutoBio tasks, one entry per family (AutoBio's task id). `goal` is the privileged task statement with AutoBio's exact thresholds (world-frame numbers are readable in that mode anyway); `goal_std` is the standard-mode statement: the same goal with every threshold relative, never a world coordinate (docs/benchmarks/autobio.md, World-frame information). `title` and `level` are the AutoBio paper's task name and difficulty level; `robot` is the TAXONOMY value.

pickup.title: Pick up centrifuge tube
pickup.robot_text: an **ALOHA arm** (6 joints and a parallel gripper), fixed to the bench
pickup.goal: Pick up the 50 mL centrifuge tube that stands in the rack. Success, at the first control step where both hold: the tube's body is above z = 0.925 m (it stands at 0.830 m, so 9.5 cm up) and the gripper's left finger (geom `1/aloha:leftfinger`) touches the tube's cap (geom `1/cap_cyl`).
pickup.goal_std: Pick up the 50 mL centrifuge tube (orange screw cap) that stands in the blue rack: hold it by its cap and lift it at least 9.5 cm. Success the moment the tube is that high while the gripper holds it by the cap (the test looks for contact between the cap and the gripper's left finger, so the cap has to be between the fingers).
pickup.scene: On the bench: a 10-slot tube rack (2 rows of 5) with one capped 50 mL tube standing in it.
inventory: 50 mL centrifuge tube with an orange screw cap

thermal_cycler_close.title: Close thermal cycler lid
thermal_cycler_close.robot_text: a **UR5e** arm (6 joints) with a Robotiq 2F-85 gripper, fixed to the bench
thermal_cycler_close.goal: Close the lid of the thermal cycler and lock it. Success at the first control step where the lid's hinge (`/thermal_cycler_biorad_c1000:lid`) is within 0.01 rad of -1.9 rad (fully closed; it starts open, at 0) and the lid's lever (`/thermal_cycler_biorad_c1000:lid-lever`) is within 0.01 rad of -0.94 rad (the locked end of its travel; it starts at 0).
thermal_cycler_close.goal_std: Close the lid of the thermal cycler and lock it: the lid swung fully down (1.9 rad from where it stands open) and the lever on the lid turned to the locked end of its travel (0.94 rad). Success the moment both are within 0.01 rad of those end positions.
thermal_cycler_close.scene: On the bench: a thermal cycler (a Bio-Rad C1000 model) with its lid open. The lid carries a lever that locks it and a force knob.
inventory: thermal cycler (Bio-Rad C1000 model) with a hinged lid, a locking lever on the lid and a force knob

thermal_cycler_open.title: Open thermal cycler lid
thermal_cycler_open.robot_text: a **UR5e** arm (6 joints) with a Robotiq 2F-85 gripper, fixed to the bench
thermal_cycler_open.goal: Open the lid of the thermal cycler. It starts closed and locked: the lid's hinge (`/thermal_cycler_biorad_c1000:lid`) at -1.9 rad and its lever (`/thermal_cycler_biorad_c1000:lid-lever`) at -0.94 rad. Success at the first control step where both are within 0.003 rad of 0 (fully open).
thermal_cycler_open.goal_std: Open the lid of the thermal cycler, which starts closed and locked: turn the lever on the lid back from its locked end (0.94 rad of travel) and swing the lid fully open (1.9 rad). Success the moment the lid and its lever are both within 0.003 rad of their fully open end positions.
thermal_cycler_open.scene: On the bench: a thermal cycler (a Bio-Rad C1000 model) with its lid closed and locked by the lever on the lid.
inventory: thermal cycler (Bio-Rad C1000 model) with a hinged lid, a locking lever on the lid and a force knob

pipette.title: Aspirate with pipette
pipette.robot_text: two **UR5e** arms fixed to the bench: `arm1` carries a dexterous hand that holds a pipette (its thumb presses the plunger); `arm2` has a Robotiq 2F-85 gripper
pipette.goal: Aspirate from the 50 mL centrifuge tube with the pipette. AutoBio's test is a sequence: (1) with the plunger pressed (the thumb's target, action entry `arm1_dh_rh_thj3`, above 0.70 rad), the pipette tip is within 6.5 mm (horizontally) of the tube's axis and more than 5 mm below the liquid surface; (2) the plunger is released (the thumb's target below 0.45 rad) while the tip is still below the surface; (3) success at the first control step after (1) and (2) where the tip is more than 5 cm above the liquid surface. The tube holds 31.5 mL; the test is on positions and commands, and no liquid actually moves (AutoBio models the liquid's surface in the tube, not its transfer).
pipette.goal_std: Aspirate from the 50 mL centrifuge tube with the pipette. The test is a sequence: (1) with the plunger pressed (the thumb's target, action entry `arm1_dh_rh_thj3`, above 0.70 rad), the pipette tip is within 6.5 mm (horizontally) of the tube's axis and more than 5 mm below the liquid surface; (2) the plunger is released (the thumb's target below 0.45 rad) while the tip is still below the surface; (3) success the moment, after (1) and (2), the tip is more than 5 cm above the liquid surface. The tube is part-filled (31.5 mL); the cameras show the liquid as a blue surface inside the tube. No liquid actually moves: the test is on positions and commands.
pipette.scene: On the bench, between the arms: a rack with an open, part-filled 50 mL tube standing in it. AutoBio's prompt for this task: "one arm lifts centrifuge tube, the other aligns pipette tip and aspirates liquid"; the test itself does not ask for the tube to be lifted.
inventory: 50 mL centrifuge tube, open, part-filled with liquid
pipette with a tip, held by arm1's hand

screw_loose.title: Unscrew centrifuge tube cap
screw_loose.robot_text: two **ALOHA arms** (`arm1` and `arm2`; 6 joints and a parallel gripper each), fixed to the bench on either side of the rack
screw_loose.goal: Unscrew the cap of the 50 mL centrifuge tube and lift it off. Success at the first control step where the cap is more than 0.15 m above the tube body's origin (screwed on it sits 0.1197 m above it, so 3 cm up), `arm1`'s left finger (geom `1/aloha:leftfinger`) touches the cap (geom `6/cap_cyl`), and the cap's thread (geom `6/nut`) no longer touches the tube's (geom `7/bolt`).
screw_loose.goal_std: Unscrew the cap of the 50 mL centrifuge tube and lift it off. Success the moment the cap, held by `arm1`'s gripper (the test looks for contact between the cap and that gripper's left finger), is at least 3 cm above where it sat when screwed on and its thread is clear of the tube's.
screw_loose.scene: On the bench: a rack with a 50 mL tube standing in it, its cap screwed on. The thread is a real one: the cap comes off only by turning it. AutoBio's prompt for this task: "one stabilizes tube while the other twists cap".
inventory: 50 mL centrifuge tube with an orange screw cap, screwed on

screw_tighten.title: Screw on centrifuge tube cap
screw_tighten.robot_text: two **ALOHA arms** (`arm1` and `arm2`; 6 joints and a parallel gripper each), fixed to the bench on either side of the rack
screw_tighten.goal: Screw the cap onto the 50 mL centrifuge tube. The tube stands open in the rack; its cap lies on the bench. Success at the first control step where the cap is less than 0.123 m above the tube body's origin (fully screwed on: 0.1197 m), the cap's axis is within 5 mm of the tube's, and the cap's thread (geom `6/nut`) touches the tube's (geom `7/bolt`).
screw_tighten.goal_std: Screw the cap onto the 50 mL centrifuge tube. The tube stands open in the rack; its cap lies on the bench. Success the moment the cap is on the tube's thread, its axis within 5 mm of the tube's, and screwed down to within 3.3 mm of fully on.
screw_tighten.scene: On the bench: a rack with an open 50 mL tube standing in it, and the tube's screw cap lying on the bench. The thread is a real one: the cap goes on only by turning it. AutoBio's prompt for this task: "one grips tube while the other twists cap".

insert.title: Transfer centrifuge tube
insert.robot_text: a **UR5e** arm (6 joints) with a Robotiq 2F-85 gripper, fixed to the bench
insert.goal: Move the 50 mL centrifuge tube from the rack it stands in to the other rack, into the slot at row 0, column 4 (AutoBio's indices: `s.task.rack2.get_position(s.data, 0, 4, '50ml')`). Success at the first control step where the tube's body is within 15 mm (horizontally) of that slot's centre and its height is between 0.829 and 0.831 m (standing in a slot it is at 0.830 m).
insert.goal_std: Move the 50 mL centrifuge tube (orange screw cap) from the rack it stands in to the other rack, into the slot AutoBio calls row 0, column 4 of that rack: of its two rows the one farther from the robot's base, and in that row the end slot on the side of the first rack. Success the moment the tube stands in that slot: within 15 mm of the slot's centre and seated at the height at which a tube stands in a slot (within 1 mm).
insert.scene: On the bench: two 10-slot tube racks (2 rows of 5 each) side by side, with one capped 50 mL tube standing in one of them.
inventory: 50 mL centrifuge tube with an orange screw cap
two 10-slot tube racks (2 rows of 5 each), blue

thermal_mixer.title: Operate thermal mixer panel
thermal_mixer.robot_text: a **UR5e** arm (6 joints) with a Robotiq 2F-85 gripper, fixed to the bench
thermal_mixer.goal: Set the thermal mixer by pressing the buttons of its panel: time 30 s, temperature 33 °C, mixing speed 600 rpm. It starts at 60 s, 25 °C and 900 rpm. The episode is judged in the state in which your trajectory ends: success iff the panel is then set to exactly these three values. AutoBio's score for the task (reported as `progress`) is 0.5 x temperature + 0.3 x time + 0.2 x speed, each term the fraction of the way from the initial to the target value.
thermal_mixer.goal_std: Set the thermal mixer by pressing the buttons of its panel: time 30 s, temperature 33 °C, mixing speed 600 rpm. The panel's display shows the current settings (time, set / actual temperature, speed), and each setting has an up and a down button. The episode is judged in the state in which it ends: success iff the panel is then set to exactly these three values. The score reported as `progress` is 0.5 x temperature + 0.3 x time + 0.2 x speed, each term the fraction of the way from the initial to the target value.
thermal_mixer.scene: On the bench: a thermal mixer (an Eppendorf ThermoMixer C model) with a thermoblock on top and a front panel: a display and buttons for time, temperature and speed (up and down each), menu navigation, five program keys, `short` and `start/stop`.
inventory: thermal mixer (Eppendorf ThermoMixer C model) with a display and a button panel

insert_centrifuge_5430.title: Load centrifuge rotor
insert_centrifuge_5430.robot_text: a **UR5e** arm (6 joints) with a Robotiq 2F-85 gripper, fixed to the bench
insert_centrifuge_5430.goal: Load a second 1.5 mL tube into the centrifuge's rotor, into the slot diametrically opposite the tube that is already in it (slot 8 of 30, `s.task.slot_id`; the tube in the rotor is in slot 23). The tube to load stands in the plate on the bench. Success at the first control step where the tube's body is within 5 mm of its seated position in that slot (`s.task.final_tar_tubepose`) and its height is between 0.955 and 0.961 m. That reference position is computed when the episode starts: turning the rotor moves the slot away from it. In this instance a tube that has been let go comes to rest 5.0 to 5.1 mm from it, just outside the 5 mm (AutoBio's own expert's tube included), so the check holds while the tube is still being lowered into the slot; the episode ends at that moment.
insert_centrifuge_5430.goal_std: Load a second 1.5 mL tube into the centrifuge's rotor, into the slot diametrically opposite the tube that is already in it (the rotor has 30 slots). The tube to load stands in the plate on the bench. Success the moment the tube is seated in that slot: its body within 5 mm of its seated position there, and its body's height within a fixed 6 mm window (AutoBio's test; standard mode gives no world heights). That seated position is computed when the episode starts: turning the rotor moves the slot away from it, so leave the rotor where it is. In this instance a tube that has been let go comes to rest just outside the 5 mm (5.0 to 5.1 mm away, AutoBio's own expert's tube included), so the test holds while the tube is still being lowered into the slot, held by the gripper; the episode ends in success at that moment.
insert_centrifuge_5430.scene: On the bench: a centrifuge (an Eppendorf 5430 model) with its lid open and a 30-slot rotor holding one 1.5 mL tube, and a well plate with a second 1.5 mL tube standing in it.
inventory: centrifuge (Eppendorf 5430 model), lid open, with a 30-slot rotor
two 1.5 mL tubes with screw caps (one in the rotor, one in the plate)
